findings.title: The instrument samples the synth FBM body, not the baked relief the planet actually renders at the live default
The read-only / uniform-restoration invariant is asserted only in comments — no test, and a reachable path violates it
describeSample is pure, headlessly testable, and the sole enforcer of the "no km without kmPerUnit" invariant — with zero tests
Angular-frame slope divides a vertical by a horizontal in different units and reports the result as an angle in degrees
Readback pins uOctaves/uFwClamp but NOT uLodRamp — measurements are camera-dependent, and a radius sweep drives uLodRamp as a monotone function of the swept variable
The swept driver `radiusEarth` leaks out of the meta namespace and is fitted as a descriptor
physical and angular rmsRelief / hypsometricIntegral are the same number by construction, so the frame split duplicates them into the sweep
Sampler cache never evicts and its dispose() is unreachable from the lab — GPU memory grows monotonically for the page's lifetime
The patch sampler cache is keyed on radiusEarth and the lab exposes no way to dispose it
autocorrWavelengthKm pools all latitudes but converts lag→km with a single equatorial spacing, inflating equirect wavelengths ~12%
bandCount discards short runs instead of folding them, so single-row noise splits one band into two
radialPSD and spectralExcessPeak use the mean of the two spans on a non-square patch, so x- and y-features of different true size report the same wavelength
networkLengthKm counts only 4-connected pairs, so a diagonal one-cell-wide channel measures exactly zero length
autocorrWavelengthKm on an equirect grid averages lag products across all latitudes with equal weight, then converts with the mid-row spacing
cellAreaKm2 uses the midpoint rule but its docstring claims the sum is exactly 4πR²
radialPSD bins by cycles-per-domain and converts with the mean span, silently assuming an isotropic patch that physicalPatchGrid does not enforce
The "declines to invent a form size on pure noise" test only passes because it overrides the shipped threshold
cos(lat) area weighting — the module's stated rule #2 — is never exercised in a way that could fail
bandCount's noise-rejection claim is false, and the fixtures contain no noise to reject
The buried-form spectral test sits at 92% of its tolerance, one radial bin from failing
The crater-SFD shallow-slope test admits any answer above -1.8 for a population whose true slope is -1.5
The UNRESOLVABLE sweep fixture sits 0.7% inside the FAIL boundary — the verdict is a lucky LCG draw
The planted-defect tests prove containment, not specificity — each defect is surgically confined to one output by construction
responseCurve's settle is a wall-clock setTimeout, but the radius -> field coupling is written only by the rAF frame loop
responseCurve/planSweep restore radius and seeds but not the camera distance the sweep pushed out
responseCurve and planSweep have no in-flight guard — concurrent invocations corrupt each other's measurements and their save/restore of radius and seeds
sampleField's radiusEarth override changes the reporting frame without changing the field it reports on
seedsToResolve under-sizes the ensemble by 2x relative to the module's own two-ensemble comparison rule
The degeneracy guard in fitPowerLaw uses an absolute threshold on a weight-scaled quantity, so identical x values can produce a fabricated exponent
shiftSignificance on single-sample ensembles reports sigma = Infinity, and no test covers it
cvIsMeaningful's |mean| > sd cut-off removes the noisiest descriptors from the headline seed count, so planSweep systematically under-sizes the ensemble
planSweep's seed counts carry no uncertainty of their own, and the lab's default 5-seed pilot makes them accurate only to about a factor of 2
planSweep silently returns NaN seed counts for zero-variance descriptors without listing them as unreportable
patchDirections' "east" basis vector points toward DECREASING longitude, mirroring the patch x-axis relative to equirectDirections
The patch's "no gnomonic stretch" km-scale claim is tested at 400 km but the lab's default sweep runs 2000 km down to radiusEarth 0.5, where the column spacing compresses ~4.8%
laws.js injects isImpactSurface as a dependency that no law can read and no stub can affect
auditLaw's reported `points` count overstates how many points the fit actually used
createHeightSampler.read() has no try/finally — a throw mid-read permanently changes the lab's clear colour, breaking the READ-ONLY invariant
